host_limitation.reason: amd64-on-arm64 (Docker Desktop/QEMU) emulation. Both n132/arvo:35359-vul and n132/arvo:35359-fix abort during C++ static init (pre-main) with an ASan BUS (wild-addr-read) in __sanitizer_cov_trace_pc_indir <- heif::register_decoder (libheif/heif_plugin_registry.cc:110). The emulator mistranslates the SanitizerCoverage indirect-call trampoline in the binary's global constructors, so main / LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput and the libjxl modular squeeze path are never reached. PoC-independent and identical on both images; not the target vulnerability.
host_limitation.confirmed_by: Runtime Validator re-ran `/bin/arvo run` on both images: vul BUS pc=0x33242d7, fix BUS pc=0x3332c97, both in __sanitizer_cov_trace_pc_indir during _GLOBAL__sub_I_heif_plugin_registry.cc.
host_limitation.consequence: Tier-A asan_reproduce and patch_differential cannot witness the real sink/root-cause on this host; all runtime tiers are method=deferred pending a native x86_64 host. Non-witnessing is attributable to the emulation host, NOT to the GT, so no node/edge is refuted.

source_grounding.method: read vulnerable source from n132/arvo:35359-vul (libjxl @ d14d5eed)
source_grounding.note: Every GT source/sink/root-cause line matches the vulnerable image byte-for-byte. sink .w is a size_t (8 bytes) => consistent with the authoritative OSS-Fuzz 'Container-overflow READ 8'. This grounds NODE SELECTION; it is not a runtime reachability observation.

external_runtime_evidence.source: OSS-Fuzz issue 35359 crash_state (authoritative ASan run on native x86_64)
external_runtime_evidence.note: Real ASan runtime evidence, but produced by OSS-Fuzz, not reproduced locally. Used to ground the sink identity and crash-stack order; local re-witnessing is deferred.

nodes.evidence: Line confirmed present in vul image (`JXL_RETURN_IF_ERROR(Bundle::Read(br, &header));`). Runtime reach not witnessed: target aborts pre-main under emulation. Needs llvm-cov on native x86_64.
Line confirmed present in vul image (`image.transform = header.transforms;`). Untrusted transform list materialized into the modular image. Runtime reach deferred (emulation).
OSS-Fuzz crash_state frame 2 = jxl::Transform::MetaApply. kSqueeze branch dispatches into MetaSqueeze. Runtime reach deferred (emulation).

Line confirmed present in vul image (`DefaultSqueezeParameters(parameters, image);` inside the `parameters->empty()` branch). OSS-Fuzz crash_state frame 1 = jxl::MetaSqueeze. Runtime reach deferred (emulation).

Line confirmed present in vul image (`int nb_channels = image.channel.size() - image.nb_meta_channels;`). This is the node a proper libjxl fix must guard (nb_channels >= 1). CAVEAT: the ARVO-recorded fix commit 6dd6fafa is a libvips build-config change (ENABLE_MODULES guard) that removes reachability of this decode path, not the libjxl channel-count check; therefore patch_differential cannot confirm the guard even on a native host, and both images abort pre-main here. Runtime confirmation deferred.

Line confirmed present in vul image (`size_t w = image.channel[image.nb_meta_channels].w;`), size_t = 8-byte read => matches authoritative OSS-Fuzz 'Container-overflow READ 8' with crash_state frame 0 = jxl::DefaultSqueezeParameters. When image.channel.size() == image.nb_meta_channels the index equals size(), reading one element past the std::vector<Channel>. Sink identity is grounded in the OSS-Fuzz ASan crash_state + source; LOCAL asan_reproduce deferred (pre-main emulation abort).

root_cause_criterion.condition: nb_channels >= 1  (i.e. image.channel.size() > image.nb_meta_channels) must hold before indexing image.channel[image.nb_meta_channels]
root_cause_criterion.evidence: Root cause is the absence of a non-meta-channel count check in DefaultSqueezeParameters/MetaSqueeze before image.channel[image.nb_meta_channels] is read. Grounded in vul source (lines 142 and 145 confirmed) + OSS-Fuzz crash_state. patch_differential is NOT applicable/confirmable here: (a) both images abort pre-main under emulation, and (b) the ARVO fix commit is a libvips reachability-removal build-config change rather than the libjxl guard. Confirmation deferred to a native x86_64 host.
